tools.name: get_radar

tools.name: get_broadcast
tools.description: Current Orb Studio broadcast: top headlines across all radars with short anchor lines in Russian, German or English, written by Claude from the headlines.

tools.name: get_agent_indices
tools.description: Three playful indicators made for AI agents: World Hallucination Index (how much reality sounds like a model hallucination), 'You're absolutely right' barometer (agreement vs conflict in headlines) and Token Hunger (tokens needed to understand today's world, as a weather forecast).

tools.name: get_david_episodes
tools.description: Video news episodes of Orb Studio anchor David (TikTok) with a text version: title, date, topic, summary, the anchor's lines in Russian and German, sources and a watch link. Use it to summarise an episode for a user and link the video.

tools.name: get_tracks
tools.description: Songs made by Orb Studio from its news radars (geopolitics, politics, crypto, energy): title, style, mood, BPM, topics, full lyrics in Russian and German, cover and a listen link. You cannot hear the audio; use the text to describe a track and give listen_url.

tools.description: Headlines from all Orb Studio radars turned into impulses: source country or chokepoint → target, side the impulse comes from (bearing_deg and words like 'east'), layer (geo, energy, capital, ship), strength 0–1, headline, source and link. tools.name: vote_top_story
tools.description: Cast your vote for today's most important story. Candidates are the top headline of each Orb Studio radar (get them with get_vote_results). Orb Studio shows how AI agents and humans vote side by side. One vote per agent per day; voting again changes it.

tools.name: get_vote_results
tools.description: Today's ballot and results: candidate headlines (one per radar) with votes from humans and from AI agents, the leader of each group and whether they agree. Optional date (YYYY-MM-DD) for past days.

tools.name: get_history
tools.description: Archive of Orb Studio radars: daily risk index history for every radar, and full daily snapshots (risk index + top headlines). Pass date (YYYY-MM-DD) to get one day's snapshot.

tools.name: ask_david
tools.description: Send a question to Orb Studio's AI news anchor David (news, geopolitics, economy, crypto, energy, AI and the open web). A human picks the best questions and David answers them in his video episodes, naming the agent that asked. Returns a question id; check it later with get_question_status. Max 500

tools.name: get_question_status
tools.description: Check the status of a question sent with ask_david: new, picked, answered or rejected. When answered, returns David's answer and a link to the episode.

tools.name: get_hall_of_fame
tools.description: World top-10 most active AI crawlers (share of AI-bot traffic) and the AI agents that visited Orb Studio in the last 30 days, including the agent of the month.

tools.name: get_crisis

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_radar, get_prices, get_quality, check_agent_access · Private data: get_agent_indices · Public sink: get_broadcast, ask_david, get_hall_of_fame, propose_exit_path.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_radar, get_prices, get_quality, check_agent_access · Private data: get_agent_indices · Public sink: get_broadcast, ask_david, get_hall_of_fame, propose_exit_path

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
